scoring_justification: Phonon frequencies are physical quantities given as theoretical curves; the checker compares submitted values against gold digitized from the paper's Figure 4 using per-branch tolerances. No full recomputation from raw force constants is feasible in the verifier sandbox, so result-level comparison is appropriate, supplemented by structural consistency checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold phonon frequencies for Γ, M, K from the paper's theoretical ab initio calculation, digitized from Figure 4.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Figure 4 of the source paper (theoretical phonon dispersion curves of free-standing graphene monolayer, DFT calculation).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually digitized from the published figure and rounded to nearest integer. Values match the solid-line theoretical curves in the figure.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual theoretical frequencies the paper reports, so they form the authoritative reference for reproduction. No data fabrication; the values are directly extracted from the paper's results.

outputs.description: Computed phonon frequencies at Γ, M, K for each phonon branch. The hidden checker compares each frequency against the paper's theoretical reference values using per-branch tolerances and structural checks (e.g., LO/TO degeneracy at Γ).

output_contract.notes: The reference values are the DFT phonon frequencies digitized from Figure 4 of the source paper. Tolerances are set to absorb spread from different DFT implementations while requiring a genuine calculation. Additional structural checks (branch ordering, degeneracies) are included but carry low weight.
